title: OpenAI-compatible chat client with SSE streaming
description: Talk to a remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`/chat/completions`, `/models`) with token streaming (goal 4).
steps: Create `llm/ChatMessage.kt`: `data class LlmMessage(val role: String, val content: String)` (roles "system", "user", "assistant").
Create `llm/LlmException.kt`: `class LlmException(message: String, val httpCode: Int? = null, cause: Throwable? = null) : Exception(message, cause)`.

Create `llm/SseParser.kt`: `object SseParser { sealed interface Line { data class Delta(val text: String) : Line; data object Done : Line; data object Ignore : Line }; fun parse(line: String): Line }`. Rules: blank or starting with `:` → Ignore; `data: [DONE]` → Done; `data: <json>` → parse with `Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }` as `JsonObject`, read `choices[0].delta.content` (string); missing/null/empty → Ignore, else Delta. A JSON object with an `error` field → throw `LlmException(error.message or the raw json)`. Non-`data:` lines (e.g. `event:`) → Ignore.

Create `llm/ChatClient.kt`: `interface ChatClient { fun stream(messages: List<LlmMessage>): Flow<String>; suspend fun listModels(): List<String> }` and `class OpenAiChatClient(private val http: OkHttpClient, private val config: () -> LlmConfig) : ChatClient` with `data class LlmConfig(val baseUrl: String, val apiKey: String, val model: String, val temperature: Double = 0.3)`.

URL building: `baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"` (the user enters a base URL ending in `/v1`). Throw `LlmException("LLM endpoint is not configured")` if baseUrl or model is blank. Add header `Authorization: Bearer <key>` only if the key is not blank; `Accept: text/event-stream` for streaming.

`stream`: POST JSON `{"model":..., "messages":[{"role","content"}...], "stream": true, "temperature": ...}` built with `buildJsonObject`. Implement as `callbackFlow` or `flow { }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)`: execute the call (cancel the `Call` on flow cancellation, e.g. `currentCoroutineContext().job.invokeOnCompletion { call.cancel() }`), non-2xx → `LlmException("HTTP <code>: <first 300 chars of body>", code)`; read `body.source()` line by line with `readUtf8Line()` until null or Done, emitting each Delta. Wrap `IOException` in `LlmException("Network error: <message>")`.

Add to `AppContainer`: a separate `llmHttpClient = httpClient.newBuilder().readTimeout(300, SECONDS).build()` and `val chatClient: ChatClient = OpenAiChatClient(llmHttpClient) { val s = settingsRepository.settings.value; LlmConfig(s.llmBaseUrl, settingsRepository.apiKey(), s.llmModel) }`.
Write `llm/SseParserTest.kt` and `llm/OpenAiChatClientTest.kt` (MockWebServer; SSE body built as a string with `data: {...}\n\n` lines and header `Content-Type: text/event-stream`).
acceptanceCriteria: Test: streamed body with deltas "Hel", "lo" and `data: [DONE]` yields ["Hel", "lo"]; the recorded request path is `/v1/chat/completions`, body has `"stream":true` and the model name
Test: Authorization header is `Bearer k` when key is "k" and absent when key is blank
Test: HTTP 401 with body `{"error":"bad key"}` → LlmException with httpCode 401 and message containing `bad key`
Test: blank baseUrl → LlmException("LLM endpoint is not configured") without any request
SseParser tests: comment line, `data: [DONE]`, delta with null content, role-only first chunk, error object
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending.
